functions.name: Open the browser experiment
functions.behaviour: Serves the experiment page to a launcher URL carrying the matching token, together with its JavaScript and stylesheet assets.
functions.notes: Only the HTTP entry points are owned here; controls implemented by these assets belong to other shards. Inventory-wide provenance: source commit 3ef82a5a718be48f6ed4bd946a0efc1036f5c9b7; adapter.py SHA-256 05c4fb96f94f22ccdd00bf70a0e09d95fb38dbac1561aee032d877a13cba5cbf; keymap_catalog.py SHA-256 5d14236d2d03e89244a386e237fe50f2a988e031ea83089b20daa091bddd4734. Evidence-set SHA-256 bab1e6759cf063c7baefc73f2e19ae9578d10faf41e8fd11747720560e2eadb0 is computed from the canonical sorted JSON mapping of every evidence file path to its file SHA-256 (24 files, compact separators). Editable output is this JSON; authoring used Python 3.11.15 stdlib ast/json and stdin-supplied source inventory rows. Production command: python -u -c 'import sys, termios; mode=termios.tcgetattr(0); mode[3] &= ~(termios.ECHO | termios.ICANON); termios.tcsetattr(0, termios.TCSANOW, mode); print("ready"); source="".join(iter(sys.stdin.readline, "__S3_INVENTORY_END__\n")); exec(compile(source, "<inventory-generator>", "exec"))'.

functions.name: Read the browser workspace snapshot
functions.behaviour: Returns the current work selections, full state identity, progress, protection, library, banks, checkpoints and encoded render labels/styles. For a nonempty unexecuted draft it also supplies a copied-state prediction.

functions.name: Read a paired native workspace snapshot
functions.behaviour: Returns work and Local-cell records paired with a native snapshot of the same committed state, using an optional predecessor revision. A current ready or staged review can also supply predicted comparison objects.
functions.notes: Requires a verified native profile; native transport/cache implementation is outside this shard.

functions.name: Read model structure and names
functions.behaviour: Returns puzzle structure, Local sticker geometry, canonical cell names and all moving-orbit profiles with hosting cells, affecting caps and orientation groups.

functions.name: Save detached window layout
functions.behaviour: Saves a validated batch of window rectangles, visibility and the Puzzle detached flag, and echoes its generation. If the session is busy it returns saved=false without queuing a layout operation.
functions.notes: The local, global, keyboard, macro, operation, solve and puzzle names here validate saved layout records; they do not define or create those windows.

functions.name: Inspect a piece identity
functions.behaviour: Records an explicitly supplied piece identity and reports that piece at its current position. Native shift-left inspection maps a visible native sticker to its current occupant before recording the identity.
functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/MathematicalNameNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Inspect a fixed position
functions.behaviour: Records an explicitly supplied fixed position separately from its occupant. Native shift-right inspection maps a visible native sticker to that position.
functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/MathematicalNameNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Set Current and destination
functions.behaviour: Sets an explicit Current identity and destination in the same moving orbit and restores that orbit’s saved work context. The focus shortcut opens the editor for those separate inputs.

functions.notes: The catalogue defines these bindings; their native dispatch is outside s3. The stated shortcut behaviour is inferred from the command IDs and the linked adapter operation where present.

functions.behaviour: Captures the inspected piece’s affecting caps into the active key bank.
functions.notes: The catalogue defines these bindings; their native dispatch is outside s3. The stated shortcut behaviour is inferred from the command IDs and the linked adapter operation where present.

functions.name: Select a default physical Grip
functions.behaviour: Selects the cap assigned to a physical Grip slot, with Hold or Latch determining release behaviour. Only assigned slots are available in the active physical bank.

functions.behaviour: Lists the twelve proper ordered frames for a captured cap and saves an explicitly selected frame. Saving rechecks the bank, captured cell and previous frame to reject a stale editor.

functions.name: Read a cap’s legal axes
functions.behaviour: Returns the legal cap-axis records and inverse words, exposing both canonical one-based cell IDs and retained zero-based cell indices.

functions.name: Submit explicit physical or native turns
functions.behaviour: Appends explicit cap turns or verified native-token words to the selected draft phase, or reviews and commits them immediately when Live is explicitly selected. Input rechecks the full state hash and the selected bank/frame or native profile; live turns enforce protection and reject an outstanding preview.
functions.notes: The catalogue default Twist map is KeyA/KeyS/KeyD -> H1/H2/H3, KeyF/KeyG/KeyH/KeyJ -> T1/T2/T3/T4, KeyK/KeyL/Semicolon/Quote -> T1-/T2-/T3-/T4-. Physical key release and modifier handling are defined outside s3; their extra entry points are not duplicated here. Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/PostApprovalNativeRegression.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Choose the operation input phase

functions.name: Choose Draft or Live input

functions.name: Choose Hold or Latch Grip mode

functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/KeyboardFeedbackNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Edit explicit phase steps

functions.notes: The API implementation is direct source evidence; the phase-specific editor shortcuts are inferred from their catalogue IDs. The catalogue defines these bindings; their native dispatch is outside s3. The stated shortcut behaviour is inferred from the command IDs and the linked adapter operation where present. Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/WorkIntentNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Append or replace with a selected macro
functions.behaviour: Copies an explicitly selected library macro into a chosen phase, either appending it or replacing the phase. It preserves the exact macro ID, version, recipe and inserted span as source receipts.
functions.notes: The API append flag selects the two behaviours; it defaults to replacement when absent. Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/PostApprovalNativeRegression.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Set inverse Prepare as Cleanup
functions.behaviour: Replaces Cleanup with the chronological inverse of the exact Prepare recipe, or with an empty phase when Prepare is empty.

functions.name: Review the complete operation
functions.behaviour: Computes complete effects, collateral support, exact captured-lock and orbit conflicts, optional per-turn protection, declared-goal results, residuals and Current benefit. It publishes a ready or conflicting review bound to the current work and full state.
functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/WorkIntentNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Stage the reviewed operation preview
functions.behaviour: Stages the exact reviewed recipe as a Session preview after rechecking its review guard and protection. Replacement of an existing preview is explicit, and a failed stage restores the prior preview and execution authority.
functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/WorkIntentNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Commit the staged complete operation
functions.behaviour: Rechecks the current execution guard and commits the exact staged recipe with full collateral effects and a workflow journal receipt. It persists the resulting work transition, protection additions and any completion receipt, reporting a warning when a durable commit’s result cannot be read.
functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/WorkIntentNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Cancel the pending preview
functions.behaviour: Clears the pending Session preview and the adapter’s execution token.

functions.name: Stop running analysis

functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/StopAcknowledgementNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Start a new operation

functions.notes: Test source work/experiments/magic600-04/tests/ContinuousSolverNativeChecks.cs exercises this function; the fixture was read, not run for this inventory.

functions.name: Reuse retained operation steps
functions.behaviour: Keeps the exact retained phase steps while starting a fresh operation generation and withdrawing the old review and execution authority. An outstanding preview must be handled first.

functions.name: Undo a journal operation

entry_points: route POST /api/experiment/command action=block-add mode=exact capture_current=false position=identity
